mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment (UNRATE below 3.5%) signals improved labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when UNRATE crosses below 3.5% and remains there for 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO above 105 for 20 trading days) indicates stronger business activity, fostering optimism about economic growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: No significant positive returns when INDPRO stays above 105 for 20 consecutive days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in quarterly demand (GDPC1) create favorable conditions for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous 3-month average AND GDPC1 > previous 3-month average
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both conditions are met and sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent improvements in labor market participation (PAYEMS > 150,000) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signal robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: No returns when both conditions are met for 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% for 60 trading days signals sustained monetary easing, lowering borrowing costs and enhancing equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive despite FEDFUNDS remaining below 4.5% for 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105 for 20 days) amplifies expectations of peak growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: No returns when in late-cycle regime and INDPRO stays above 105 for 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the federal funds rate below 4.5% triggers an immediate rally in equity markets, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: No positive returns in 5 days despite FEDFUNDS falling below 4.5%.
